"44f5ec04-b094-507a-beff-1d5d8144c102"] [:db/add "44f5ec04-b094-507a-beff-1d5d8144c102" :question/problem "Without using a calculator, find the **exact** value.

$$
\cos^2\left(105^\circ\right)-\sin^2\left(105^\circ\right)
$$"] [:db/add "44f5ec04-b094-507a-beff-1d5d8144c102" :question/worked-solution "Use the cosine double-angle identity:

$$
\cos^2\left(x\right)-\sin^2\left(x\right)=\cos(2x)
$$

Substitute the angle and evaluate the standard-angle cosine:

$$
\begin{aligned}
&\cos^2\left(105^\circ\right)-\sin^2\left(105^\circ\right) \\
&= \cos\left(2\cdot 105^\circ\right) \\
&= \cos\left(210^\circ\right) \\
&= -\cos\left(30^\circ\right) \\
&= -\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}
\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "44f5ec04-b094-507a-beff-1d5d8144c102" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "44f5ec04-b094-507a-beff-1d5d8144c102" :question/answer-fields "3319f386-5192-550e-8071-983b2dee71bc"] [:db/ensure "44f5ec04-b094-507a-beff-1d5d8144c102" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186087671 :knowledge-point/questions "44f5ec04-b094-507a-beff-1d5d8144c102"] [:db/add "abca0a98-3a7c-59cf-9ca1-fafec142d1fd" :answer/id #uuid "abca0a98-3a7c-59cf-9ca1-fafec142d1fd"] [:db/add "abca0a98-3a7c-59cf-9ca1-fafec142d1fd" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "abca0a98-3a7c-59cf-9ca1-fafec142d1fd" :answer/value "\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}"] [:db/ensure "abca0a98-3a7c-59cf-9ca1-fafec142d1fd" :answer/validate] [:db/add "b986ae9e-4087-54bd-b45f-4652562f4456" :answer-field/id #uuid "b986ae9e-4087-54bd-b45f-4652562f4456"] [:db/add "b986ae9e-4087-54bd-b45f-4652562f4456" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "b986ae9e-4087-54bd-b45f-4652562f4456" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "b986ae9e-4087-54bd-b45f-4652562f4456" :answer-field/choices "abca0a98-3a7c-59cf-9ca1-fafec142d1fd"] [:db/add "b986ae9e-4087-54bd-b45f-4652562f4456" :answer-field/correct "abca0a98-3a7c-59cf-9ca1-fafec142d1fd"] [:db/ensure "b986ae9e-4087-54bd-b45f-4652562f4456" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "7b49733d-b3b2-51bc-8e25-b9e8f9358d07" :question/id #uuid "7b49733d-b3b2-51bc-8e25-b9e8f9358d07"] [:db/add "7b49733d-b3b2-51bc-8e25-b9e8f9358d07" :question/problem "Without using a calculator, find the **exact** value.

{{field-1}}"] [:db/add "7b49733d-b3b2-51bc-8e25-b9e8f9358d07" :question/worked-solution "Use the cosine double-angle identity:

$$
2\cos^2\left(x\right)-1=\cos(2x)
$$

Substitute the angle and evaluate the standard-angle cosine:

$$
\begin{aligned}
&2\cos^2\left(15^\circ\right)-1 \\

$$
\begin{aligned}
&\cos^4\left(15^\circ\right) \\
&\quad -2\cos^2\left(15^\circ\right)\sin^2\left(15^\circ\right) \\
&\quad +\sin^4\left(15^\circ\right)=
\end{aligned}
$$
{{field-1}}"] [:db/add "284fa8b1-a821-55e3-a0ff-4cb6b704414a" :question/worked-solution "Let $E$ denote the expression in the question. Recognize the expanded perfect square:

$$
\begin{aligned}
E &= \left(\cos^2\left(15^\circ\right)-\sin^2\left(15^\circ\right)\right)^2
\end{aligned}
$$

Use the cosine double-angle identity:

$$
\cos^2\left(x\right)-\sin^2\left(x\right)=\cos(2x)
$$

Substitute the angle and evaluate the standard-angle cosine:

$$
\begin{aligned}
&\cos^2\left(15^\circ\right)-\sin^2\left(15^\circ\right) \\
&= \cos\left(2\cdot 15^\circ\right) \\
&= \cos\left(30^\circ\right) \\
&= \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}
\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, square the value:

$$
\begin{aligned}
E &= \left(\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\right)^2 \\
&= \frac{3}{4}
\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "284fa8b1-a821-55e3-a0ff-4cb6b704414a" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "284fa8b1-a821-55e3-a0ff-4cb6b704414a" :question/answer-fields "fb340e38-8dd4-5b77-a433-f4428ee9543a"] [:db/ensure "284fa8b1-a821-55e3-a0ff-4cb6b704414a" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186087671 :knowledge-point/questions "284fa8b1-a821-55e3-a0ff-4cb6b704414a"] [:db/add "generator" :question-generator/id #uuid "270a33a7-6203-5a32-80c4-dfd3d40556c2"] [:db/add "generator" :question-generator/script "generators/06/0662caf122bf49285656896e1b884ddc5bc8b24f21bca7e483b3a95d3d0fb773/generator.py"] [:db/add 17592186087671 :knowledge-point/question-generator "generator"] [:db/ensure 17592186087671 :knowledge-point/validate] [:db/cas 17592186699252 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186699259 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186699260 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186699263 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186699269 :question/retired nil true] [:db/cas 17592186702810 :question/retired nil true]]
